title: After a tournament that finishes past midnight, the Tournament panel shows yesterday's Final line under the new day and offers no Start button until reload
steps: Play casts 1 and 2 (Space to cast / strike / hold to reel)
Turn the calendar day (__angler.setDay(101); the real clock cannot be used in test mode because ?day pins it)
Play casts 3-5 (they continue on the run's own day 100, which is correct; the run finishes, streak 1)
expected: Day 101 panel (West Pond, target Minnow) with a Start tournament button; yesterday's result shown only as history
actual: Header says Day 101 / West Pond / Minnow, but the panel shows 'Final: 0 points - no medal this time - streak 1' (day 100's result) and NO Start button, so the new day cannot be started until the page is reloaded
suspect: game/games/angler/angler.js:749 renderTourney: g.tourResult is never cleared, so the first branch always wins and the Start branch is unreachable (g.tourResult is set in afterTourCast ~line 721)

title: At 195x422 the touch pads start below the fold and the hit line sits on the screen edge; the page must be scrolled by hand during a song
steps: Open /game/games/jam/index.html?test=1 at 195x422 touch, Got it, Play: Warm Embers (Easy)
Look at the first screen of the song
expected: Lanes and the four pads visible together without scrolling
actual: Header + 3 HUD rows push the canvas to y=261 (150x197 px); pads are at y=470..526 in a 422 px viewport (page scrollHeight 542). Only after scrolling 120 px do lanes and pads fit together, and then the score/combo HUD is scrolled away. Real touch taps on the pads work (60/60 perfect at 195 and 390 once scrolled). Menu and touch wording are fine.
suspect: game/games/jam/jam.css (header/HUD stacking at <=200 px, canvas-wrap size); no scroll-into-view when a song starts

title: Tournament cast card says 'All medals won. Chase your best!' on a brand-new journal
steps: Fresh storage, Angler (?test=1&day=100), Tournament > Start tournament, cast and hold the whole fight so the line snaps
expected: A goal that matches a fresh save (first catch / first medal)
actual: Both cast cards (1/5 and 2/5) end with 'All medals won. Chase your best!' although nothing was caught. The running total line itself is now correct.
suspect: game/games/angler/angler.js next-goal text (~line 284-300) when the tournament line replaces the goal list
